label: Defining FO4 from stage delay
subgoals: Set g to 1 and h to 4 for an inverter with four copies as load
Multiply by tau to get the FO4 delay in picoseconds

label: Measuring tau from FO4
subgoals: Divide the measured FO4 delay by four plus p_inv
Fit delay against fanout to separate slope and intercept
Read tau from the slope and p_inv tau from the intercept

label: Thinking in FO4 units
subgoals: Divide a cycle time by the FO4 delay
Subtract flop and skew overhead to get usable logic depth
Use FO4 counts to sanity-check timer results across nodes
